items.text: Scientists found a fossilized jawbone that has clues about Europe’s earliest humans, and they described the discovery as the ‘face of the first European’. They found the fossil near caves in the mountains in Spain’s Burgos province, and they estimate that it could be about 1.4 million years old. The facial bones belong to the Homo genus; it is one of the first populations that colonized the European continent. The discovery comes from a period with little evidence of humans in Europe, and scientists hope that the fossil will help them identify the species. They are still working to identify the specific kind of human ancestor , and they believe that the discovery will also help them study the evolution of human faces. Difficult words: jawbone (the bone of the mouth), colonize (to come to a place and live there), ancestor (a person who lived a long time ago). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Scientists found the bone of the face of the oldest human in Europe. The discovery happened in the mountains of northern Spain at a popular archaeological site . Scientists found several bones there before, but this bone was the oldest one. It was about 1.4 million years old, and it belonged to the Homo genus. Scientists believed that Homo genus was the oldest species of humans who came to Europe. We have very little evidence about humans from this period of time, so the discovery is very important. Scientists say that it will help them study how human faces evolved . Difficult words: archaeological site (a place with animal or past human parts), species (a group of similar animals or plants), evolve (to change over time). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists in northern Spain find a bone . It is a bone of a human . It is a face bone. Scientists find other bones before. None of them is so old. Scientists believe that the bone is 1.4 million years old. It belongs to the oldest humans in Europe. The name of the species is Homo genus. Scientists know only very little about this time from human history. The bone is very important for them. They can study how the human face changes over time. Difficult words: bone (the hard part inside a body to make it move), human (a person), species (a group of similar people, animals, or plants). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The average age of fathers in England and in Wales has increased from 31 in the early 90s to 33 today, and with Britain’s obesity -ridden , binge drinking culture, it probably could be argued that men are not doing themselves many favours. An 18-year-old man might not be anywhere near thinking about having children, but Dr. Kevin Smith says that earlier fatherhood should be promoted to young men and the NHS should support them in freezing their sperm. This is to avoid the risk of children suffering genetic disorders, as the sperm of older men apparently contains larger numbers of mutations, meaning that it is more prone to things like autism and schizophrenia. Men in their 40s or older might prefer to use frozen younger sperm rather than the fresh stuff . It could be argued that sperm freezing not only provides an artificial approach to reproduction, but also a false sense of security – freezing a man’s sperm does not necessarily guarantee men a baby. Difficult words: -ridden (be full of), binge drinking (drinking a lot), promote (to tell someone to do something), NHS (National Health Service), prone to (likely to suffer from), fresh stuff idiom (material that is not created right then), artificial (unnatural). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The average age of fathers in England and Wales in the early 1990s was 31. Now, it is 33 – fathers are getting older and older. This is not a good thing when it comes to the health of the child. The sperm of older men contain larger number of mutations and the child is then more prone to disease. One British doctor suggests that 18 year-old men freeze their sperm. When they’re older and they want to have babies, they can use their frozen sperm. So what do you think? Freezing eggs from women planning families isn’t that unusual, is it? Difficult words: mutation (the process of mutating – changing of the DNA, which is not good), prone to (likely to suffer from). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Fathers in England are getting older. In the 1990s, they were 31. Now, they are 33. Younger fathers have healthier children, so this is a problem. One British doctor has a solution . He suggests that young men freeze their sperm . When the man is old, and he wants to have a baby, he can use his frozen sperm. Difficult words: solution (something that you do to solve or stop a problem), suggest (to say), freeze (to make really cold), sperm (the things which come out of the penis when men have sex). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Serbian star Novak Djokovic won his fourth consecutive Wimbledon title and the seventh title overall. His opponent, Australian Nick Kyrgios, qualified for the final after Rafael Nadal pulled out due to injury. Despite the play in his first grand slam final, Kyrgios played hard, and he served 30 aces. He showed no concerns he might be number 3; however, the experienced Djokovic eventually seized control of the game. Djokovic won Wimbledon men’s singles title in 2018, 2019, and 2021; 2020 was canceled due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Djokovic is now one grand slam title behind the all-time record set by Rafael Nadal. After the game, Djokovic said Kyrgios was an amazing talent, and the tournament and trophy meant everything to him. Difficult words: consecutive (follow one another without an interruption), pull out (to stop involvement in an activity), grand slam (a set of four major championships in tennis). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last weekend, Novak Djokovic won his seventh Wimbledon title. In the final, he beat Australian Nick Kyrgios. Djokovic qualified for the final after Rafael Nadal stopped at Wimbledon because of injury. It was the first final for Kyrgios, and Djokovic was the game favorite , but Kyrgios wasn’t afraid of the Serbian star. He played very well, and he served 30 aces. Djokovic still won his fourth consecutive Wimbledon title in men’s singles. After the game, Djokovic said that Kyrgios played very well and was talented. Also, Djokovic said that the Wimbledon final wasn’t the last for Kyrgios. Difficult words: qualify (to be ready officially), favorite (the player who most people think will win), consecutive (one after another without a break). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Novak Djokovic is a Serbian tennis star. He is 35 years old. Last weekend, Djokovic wins his seventh Wimbledon title . In the final , Australian Nick Kyrgios plays against Djokovic. Kyrgios normally cannot play in the final. He can play because Rafael Nadal cannot. Nadal is hurt. Kyrgios never plays in the final before. Most people think that Djokovic will win. Kyrgios plays very well. He is not afraid of Djokovic. In the end, Djokovic wins. He wins his fourth Wimbledon title without a break . He is very happy. He says that Kyrgios is a great player. Difficult words: title (the position of the best player or team), final (the game of the two best players or teams), without a break (to do something with no stop). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A study carried out by Washington State University asked 122 men and women to take a maths test and then guess how well they had done. The guinea pig men and women were then told their scores and asked to take another test. After the second test, there was no information offered about how they had done, but they were asked to guess their results instead. It turned out that men consistently thought they had done better than they actually had. The women’s estimations , on the other hand, were right on the money . Although the sample was quite small, researchers say that gender gaps in areas like science, engineering, and maths may be the result of men thinking too highly of their performance. The report also shows the potential need for positive illusions. Difficult words: estimation (a guess), right on the money idiom (correct), sample (the people who are studied). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A study carried out at Washington State University asked men and women to take a maths test. Both groups then guessed their results. It turns out that the men overestimated themselves. The women, however, guessed with a lot more precision on how well they did. Experts only asked 122 people to take the test, but the experts say that the study may also show the need for positive illusions. Difficult words: study noun (a scientific research), overestimate (if you overestimate somebody, you think that he or she is better than he or she really is), precision (the quality of being exact or correct). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Experts carry out a study . There are 122 people. They are in two groups. One group is for men. Another group is for women. Experts give both groups a maths test. After the test, the people guess their results . Men think that their results are better than they really are. Women are very good at guessing their results. Difficult words: study noun (a situation when experts study something), carry out (to organise, to do), guess (when you do not know something, you can guess it – try to say something), result (an answer). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Argentina, archaeologists found fossils of a ferocious dinosaur. The fossils will give insight into the evolution of some of the biggest predators on Earth. The new predatory dinosaur had tiny arms like the T-Rex, and scientists named it Meraxes gigas after a dragon from the book series ‘Game of Thrones’. For scientists, the fossil is important because it’s the first complete fossil of a carcharodontosaur. It’s so complete that scientists can study everything from the whole arm down to the smallest toes, the whole foot, and the length of the head. Although the animal weighed four tons, its arms were just over 60 centimeters long, which scientists say is absurdly short. Difficult words: ferocious (cruel or violent), insight (a deep understanding), absurd (illogical or impossible to believe). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Archaeologists in Argentina found a fossil of a new dinosaur. They called it Meraxes gigas after a dragon from a popular TV series. The dinosaur is in a group of dinosaurs called a carcharodontosaur. This dinosaur was very aggressive, and it was one of the biggest predators on Earth. For scientists, the discovery was important because the fossil had all its body parts. Scientists can learn many things from it. The fossil had both arms, both legs, and a big head. Scientists were very surprised to see how small the animal’s arms were. The dinosaur weighed about four tons, and its arms were only 60 centimeters long. Difficult words: fossil (the hard rock of an animal or plant that lived a long time ago), predator (an animal which eats other animals), discovery (the time to learn or find something new). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists in Argentina find a fossil of a new dinosaur . They call the dinosaur Meraxes gigas. The name is after a dragon from a famous TV series. The dinosaur is a predator. A predator eats other animals. The dinosaur is very dangerous. The fossil is very special. It has all the body parts. Scientists see the head, arms, and feet. It is the first time that scientists find the whole fossil of this kind of dinosaur. They can learn many things about the animal. Scientists are surprised at how small the animal’s arms are. The animal weighs about four tons. Its arms are only 60 centimeters long. Difficult words: fossil (a part of an animal or plant that lives a long time ago), dinosaur (a large animal which lives millions of years ago), weigh (to be heavy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Saturday, thousands of people protested in Sri Lanka. In one of the largest anti-government rallies this year, they demanded President Gotabaya Rajapaksa to resign due to a huge economic crisis. Protesters in Sri Lanka’s capital Colombo clashed with police, and they broke through barriers in front of the president’s official home. Police fired teargas to control the crowds; however, the demonstrators stormed the building. The president left on Friday ahead of the planned demonstrations, so he wasn’t inside the home when hundreds of people entered. Footage circulated on social media that showed people bathing in a swimming pool inside the president’s house. Thousands of people also broke open the gates of the presidential secretariat and the finance ministry. Difficult words: rally (a large meeting of people for a political protest), circulate (to move without interruption), secretariat (an administrative office). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last weekend, thousands of people protested in Sri Lanka against the government. The country is going through a big crisis, and people weren’t satisfied with the government’s solutions. Protesters gathered at the president’s residence in Sri Lanka’s capital of Colombo where they fought with police. Hundreds of protesters broke through the barriers , and they entered the building. Videos on social media showed people in a swimming pool in the residence. People shouted that they wanted the president to resign . The president wasn’t in the building. He left one day before because he knew that protests were coming. Difficult words: residence (the official home of a politician or other important person), barrier (a fence to block people), resign (to leave a job or office). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Sri Lanka has many problems now. People have no money for food. They are angry. They say that the government doesn’t work to end the crisis . People start many protests. Last weekend, people protest in the capital Colombo. Thousands of people are in front of the president’s official home. They fight with police. They get through the barriers . They run inside the building. The president is not there. He leaves one day before the protests. Some people swim in his pool. They shout. They want the president to resign . Some officials say that they will resign. Difficult words: crisis (a very difficult or dangerous time), barrier (a fence to stops someone), resign (to leave a job or office). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Friday, Japan’s former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe died after a man shot him while he was campaigning for a parliamentary election. The 67-year-old Abe was Japan’s longest serving minister. He served two terms before he stepped down in 2020 because of health problems; however, he remained a dominant person in politics. On Friday morning, Abe was in the western city of Nara, giving a speech on a street, when suddenly, a man opened fire on him from behind with an apparently homemade gun. Police arrested the 41-year-old man, who later said he was dissatisfied with Abe, and he wanted to kill him. After a search, police found several other handmade guns at the suspect’s house. People airlifted Abe to the hospital; however, he suffered two bullet wounds to his neck and heart, and he died a few hours later. The assassination shocked Japan, a country where political violence is rare, and guns are tightly controlled. Difficult words: campaign (organized activities that lead to a goal, often in politics), dominant (important and powerful), assassination (the murder of someone famous or important). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Shinzo Abe was the former Prime Minister of Japan. He was the longest serving minister, and he stepped down in 2020 because of health problems. After stepping down, Abe continued to be active in politics. Last Friday, he spoke in public in the city of Nara. Suddenly, a man shot him from behind. Abe fell but still alive. A helicopter took him to hospital where he died. Police arrested a 41-year-old man who killed Abe with a homemade gun. The man later said that he didn’t like Abe, and he wanted to kill him. The attack shocked Japan. The country has strict gun laws, and attacks on politicians are rare. Difficult words: serve (to work for someone or for an organization), step down (to end in an important position or office), homemade (make something at home and not buy in a shop). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the past, Shinzo Abe is the Prime Minister of Japan. He is the minister for the longest time in Japan’s history. In 2020, Abe ends in his job. He has health problems. He is 67 years old. Abe continues to work in government. Last Friday, he is in the city of Nara. He is speaking in front of many people on a street. A man shoots Abe. Abe falls to the ground. He is hurt but alive . A helicopter takes him to hospital. Abe dies there. Police arrest a 41-year-old man. This man says that he hates Abe. He wants to kill him. The event is a shock for people in Japan. It has strong rules about guns. Difficult words: Prime Minister (the leader of a government), alive (not dead), shock (something that nobody expects). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Russian police released security camera footage showing the moment that a truck ploughed into a supermarket in Irkutsk, one of Siberia’s largest cities. The truck was going quite fast and seriously injured one shopper. The driver, who was unharmed , reportedly said that the brakes failed. Difficult words: footage (a video), plough (drive), unharmed (not harmed – not hurt), reportedly (according to what somebody said). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Russian police released security camera video which shows the moment that a truck drove into a supermarket. The incident happened in Irkutsk, one of Siberia’s largest cities. The truck was going quite fast and seriously injured one shopper. The truck driver was unharmed . People say that he said that the brakes on the truck failed. Difficult words: unharmed (not harmed – not hurt), brakes (the things on a truck/car which make it slow down or stop). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is an incident in Irkutsk. It is a city in Siberia. A truck drives into a supermarket. A security camera films the moment. The truck is going quite fast. It seriously injures one shopper. The driver is uninjured. He says that the brakes do not work. Difficult words: seriously (badly), injure (make problems with the body), brakes (the things on a truck/car which make it slow down or stop). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

For more than a millennium, Kyoto was Japan’s capital, until the 19th century, when the title relocated to Tokyo. Millions of tourists admired Kyoto’s ancient shrines, temples, gardens, and famous foods. However, the ancient city’s residents were weary of so many foreign tourists who crowded the streets and often ignored etiquette . Two years ago, Japan closed its doors to overseas visitors, and the absence of tourists devastated Kyoto. It was already struggling to overcome a financial crisis. In 2019, the population of Kyoto was 1.45 million, and more than 50 million visitors brought in a huge amount of income. Now, Kyoto is longing for more tourists and for the money that they brought. Hotel owners say that business is 10% to 30% of normal from before the pandemic. Difficult words: weary (very tired), etiquette (the rules or customs of polite behavior in society), long for (to want something very much). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Kyoto was Japan’s capital for more than one thousand years. It changed in the 19 th century when Tokyo became the capital, but Kyoto stayed one of the most important Japanese cities. Millions of tourists visited Kyoto every year to see its old temples and gardens and to taste its food. In 2019, 50 million visitors came to the city; its population was 1.45 million. The city was full of tourists, and local people complained about too many cars and too many visitors. Also, the visitors often didn’t follow rules and Japanese etiquette . In 2019, the pandemic came, and the city became very quiet. Local businesses struggled , and after Japan opened to tourists again, only about 10% to 30% of people came. Local people wish that more tourists visit again with money. Difficult words: temple (a building where people talk to a god), etiquette (the rules of how to behave well among other people), struggle (to deal with a difficult situation). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Kyoto is an old Japanese city. It is the capital of Japan for more than one thousand years. Tokyo changes to the capital in the 19 th century. 1.45 million people live in Kyoto. Every year, millions of tourists visit Kyoto. They want to see its old temples and gardens. They want to eat local food. In 2019, 50 million tourists visit Kyoto. Local people are not happy. Too many cars are in the streets. Too many tourists are everywhere. Some tourists don’t follow rules. In 2019, everything changes. The coronavirus starts. Japan closes to foreign tourists. Kyoto is quiet. Now, tourists can visit Japan again. Sadly, only 10% to 30% of tourists visit. Few people visit. Local people want more tourists to come. Difficult words: tourist (a person who travels or visits a place), temple (a building where people talk to a god), foreign (from another country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Technology companies suspect North Korean hackers committed a $100 million robbery on a California blockchain company called Harmony. It confirmed that they hacked some of its software that uses cryptocurrency to move across different blockchains. A blockchain security company called Elliptic Enterprises tracks stolen cryptocurrency. They said that the hackers are the Lazarus Group, and they stole user name and password credentials for Harmony employees to break into the platform. The Lazarus Group has an unknown number of individuals led by North Korea, and experts believe that the government supports by the group. North Korean hackers are increasingly sophisticated. In 2021, they stole an estimated $400 million, mostly in Ether ; however, the total for 2022 has already passed that number. The group’s biggest hack happened in 2014 when the group attacked Sony Pictures Entertainment, and they cost caused $15 million in damages. Difficult words: blockchain (a system of transactions in cryptocurrency), password credential (a username and password), Ether (the cryptocurrency of global software platform Ethereum). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A company helps stop criminal activity in the world of cryptocurrency . They said that North Korean hackers stole $100 million from California blockchain company Harmony. The hackers are named the Lazarus Group. They stole information about usernames and passwords to get into the company. Nobody really knows who belongs in the group, but the North Korean government leads it. People believe that the stolen money supports the North Korean government. The hackers are becoming more skilled, and they steal more money every year. Last year, they stole about $400 million in cryptocurrency, and the number is already higher this year. In 2014, the group broke into Sony’s system, and the attack cost the company $15 million. Difficult words: cryptocurrency (digital money), hacker (a person who breaks into somebody’s technology or computer to steal something), blockchain (a system of business deals in digital money). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A hacker is a person who knows a lot about technology. He knows how to get into somebody’s computer. He steals important information or money. The Lazarus Group is a group of North Korean hackers. The North Korean government leads the group. Experts believe that the group steals money for the government. Experts do not know how many people are in the group. They are more successful every year. They steal more and more money. Last year, they steal about $400 million in cryptocurrency . The number is already higher this year. Harmony is a California blockchain company. Blockchain is a special technology. It makes transactions in digital money. The Lazarus Group gets into Harmony’s computers. They steal Harmony’s usernames and passwords. Also, they steal $100 million. Difficult words: cryptocurrency (digital money), transaction (an action to buy or sell something), username (a name or other word that a person uses to get into a technology). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Attacks using corrosive liquids are on the rise across the UK, arguably because unlike guns and large knives, they are easy to obtain and legal to keep. Penalties for an acid attack can be lighter, as well. Acid burns are extremely painful and leave the victim scarred for life. On the Internet, there is a video on what to do if you witness an acid attack. It is essential to act quickly to dilute the acid. Run to the nearest source of water and get ahold of as much as 60 litres of water. Use only clean water, as dirty water can cause severe infection. Remove all jewellery and clothing that had contact with the acid and keep washing the victim for up to 45 minutes until the burning sensation stops. Do not apply any kind of cream to the affected area and get the victim to a hospital burns unit. Difficult words: corrosive liquids (acids or bases), arguably (possibly), obtain (get), penalty (punishment for doing something illegal), essential (very important), dilute (water down). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Acid attacks are on the rise in the UK. This could be because people can easily buy an acid unlike a large knife or a gun. It is legal to keep acid and penalties for an acid attack can be lighter, as well. Acid burns are extremely painful and leave the victim scarred for life. One video on the Internet shows what to do if you witness an acid attack. It is very important to act quickly to water down the acid. Get as much as 60 litres of water. Avoid dirty water, which can spread infection. Remove all jewellery and clothing that had contact with the acid and keep washing the victim for up to 45 minutes until the burning sensation stops. Do not apply any kind of cream to the affected area and get the victim to a hospital burns unit. Difficult words: penalty (a punishment for doing something illegal), victim (a person who is attacked), witness (a person who sees a crime). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are more and more acid attacks in the UK. This is because you can easily buy an acid. Buying a gun or a large knife is not easy. Punishments for acid attacks are also lighter . Acid burns your skin. It is extremely painful. It leaves scars for life. To help someone, you must get a lot of water. You need to get as much as 60 litres. Use only clean water. Remove clothing and jewellery. Pour water on the person. Do this for up to 45 minutes. Do not put any cream on the burns. Get the person to hospital. Difficult words: acid (a chemical which burns), punishment (paying money or going to prison for doing something bad), lighter (not as bad), pour (put). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the northern Italian Alps, at least nine people died after a glacier collapsed on Sunday. The slide sent ice, snow, and rock onto a popular trail on the Marmolada Mountain, and the avalanche killed at least seven people, including three Italians and two Czechs. Emergency officials said that the collapse injured several people; however, they didn’t know the number of mountaineers involved in the accident, and rescue efforts were still underway. The cause of the glacier’s collapse wasn’t immediately clear. Italy’s Prime Minister Mario Draghi said that the incident was without doubt linked to climate change. In recent years, the area has been experiencing unusually high temperatures. The climate of the Alps is changing rapidly , and scientists say that the glaciers have lost half their ice mass since 1850. Since the late 1800s, loss rates increased, and glaciers are now more unstable. Difficult words: avalanche (a mass of snow, ice, and rocks that fall from a mountain), mountaineer (a person who climbs mountains), rapidly (very quickly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Sunday, a glacier collapsed on the Marmolada Mountain in the Italian Alps. Ice and rock killed at least nine people, and several people went to hospital. Many people were still missing, and officials didn’t know the exact number of people. Helicopters searched for mountaineers , but they had to stop because of bad weather. The Italian Prime Minister said that the cause of the glacier’s collapse wasn’t known, but climate change probably affected it. In recent years, temperatures in the Alps grew a lot, and since 1850, the glaciers lost half of their ice. Glaciers are becoming less strong, and some parts collapse often. Difficult words: glacier (a river or mountain of ice which moves slowly), collapse (to fall suddenly), mountaineer (a person who climbs mountains). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Marmolada is a mountain in the Italian Alps. A glacier is on Marmolada. A glacier is a river or mountain of ice. It moves slowly. On Sunday, the glacier on Marmolada breaks . Ice and rock fall down the mountain. Nine people die. Several people are hurt. Many people are missing. Rescuers in helicopters look for them. They must stop. The weather is bad. They do not know how many people are on the mountain. Officials don’t know the exact reason the glacier breaks. They think one reason maybe is warm temperatures. The weather in the Alps is getting warmer every year. Glaciers melt . They move fast. They break more often than in the past. Difficult words: break (to separate a part from a larger thing), reason (why something happens), melt (to change snow or ice into water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A trip to the art museum could have turned into a very costly trip for one child in Taiwan when he lost his balance and put his hand through a painting worth around $1.5 million. “Flowers” by Italian master Paolo Porpora was part of a Taipei exhibition of artwork by or influenced by Leonardo da Vinci. Organisers did not believe that the boy intentionally vandalised the oil painting, saying that it was obvious that he did not mean to push it. The exhibition organisers decided not to charge the boy for the damage and said that the painting could be easily restored . However, this made them reconsider displaying valuable paintings in the open . Difficult words: intentionally (on purpose), restore (fix to original condition), in the open (close to where people are). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Taipei, there is an exhibition of artwork by Leonardo da Vinci, and by artists who he influenced . One boy at the exhibition lost his balance and put his hand through a painting. That painting is worth around $1.5 million. A camera filmed the moment when this happened. You can see that the boy did not do this on purpose . He was probably listening to his teacher and was not looking where he was going. The exhibition organisers will not charge the boy. They say that the painting can be easily restored. However, this incident can make people think about protecting paintings in the future. Difficult words: influence (if an artist is influenced by another artists, their work is similar), on purpose (if you do something on purpose, you want to do it), charge (to say that somebody did something bad and make them go to court). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Taipei, there is an exhibition . It is an exhibition of paintings. Many paintings are by Leonardo da Vinci. A boy is at the exhibition. He is next to a painting. He is listening to his teacher. He does not look where he’s going. He loses his balance . He pushes a hole in the painting. A camera films this. The painting is worth $1.5 million. The boy did not want to do this. He is not in trouble. People can fix the painting. Difficult words: exhibition (an event where you can see famous artwork), lose balance (when you fall over), hole (a little space). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2021 after travel restrictions lifted, more than 5 million people arrived in the Italian town of Venice. During 2022’s Easter weekend, 120,000 arrived. Some tourists were particularly disrespectful: some of them swam in the lagoons, or they had picnics on top of historic monuments. The local council worked on a scheme to regulate tourism, and now starting in January 2023, tourists will pay an entry fee to access the city center. Authorities say that the main goal is to reach out to tourists instead of profit. Over 30,000 to 40,000 day-trippers visit Venice just for a few hours. Authorities want to attract those tourists who want to discover the town and fall in love with it. The city also approved a plan to upgrade its commercial activities and to promote local artisans over cheap Chinese souvenirs, like plastic reproductions of carnival masks. Difficult words: scheme (an organized plan), artisan (a person who’s skilled at work with his hands), reproduction (a copy of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 2021, more than 5 million tourists visited the Italian town of Venice, and in 2022, 120,000 people visited it during Easter weekend. The situation became critical. Some tourists swam in the lagoons , or they had picnics on historic monuments. Over 30,000 to 40,000 people visited Venice every day, and most of them stayed for only a few hours. They couldn’t enjoy the atmosphere or fall in love with the place. Authorities decided to change the situation, and they made a plan. After January 2023, all visitors will have to pay to get to the city center. Authorities also want to reduce the sale of cheap plastic souvenirs and support local artists. Difficult words: lagoon (an area of seawater which is separated from the sea), atmosphere (the mood or feeling of a place), souvenir (a thing that is a reminder of a place or event). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Venice is a historic town in Italy. More than 5 million tourists visit Venice last year. Over 30,000 people visit it every day. Most people stay only for a few hours. They don’t feel the atmosphere of Venice. They don’t follow the rules. They swim in the lagoons . They have picnics on monuments. Local people say that tourists change recently. They don’t want to get to know the town. Authorities want to change the situation. After January 2023, people will pay to get to the center of Venice. Vendors will also sell less cheap plastic things to tourists. Authorities want local artists to sell their products. Difficult words: historic (old), atmosphere (the feeling of a place), lagoon (a lake of sea water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Jerusalem Nano Bible company developed a chip smaller than 5 by 5 millimetres. which manages to contain the original Greek version of the New Testament , making it the smallest Bible in the world. The tiny square chip can be embedded inside of watches and into pendants with infinite possibilities in the jewellery industry. The company’s aim is to be able to mass produce it and put it into every pocket. The company plans on producing a nano-sized Old Testament , as well. An academic scholar validated the product and confirmed the Greek text on the chip was indeed that of the 27 books of the New Testament. Difficult words: New Testament (the second part of the Christian Bible, written originally in Greek), tiny (very small), embed (to implant), pendant (a piece of jewellery that hangs from a chain), validate (check), Old Testament (the first part of the Christian Bible). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

An Israeli company developed a small square chip. Each side measures 4.76 millimetres. This chip is tiny , but it contains the New Testament in the original Greek version. All 27 books of it are written on the chip. The company plans to mass produce it and put it in everyone’s pockets. Because it is so small, it fits inside watches and jewellery. The possibilities are limitless. The company also plans to produce a chip with the Old Testament . Difficult words: tiny (very small), New Testament (the second part of the Christian Bible, written originally in Greek), Old Testament (the first part of the Christian Bible). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A company from Israel makes a chip. It is really small. It is like a square. Each side is 4.76 millimetres long. People write the New Testament on the chip. All 27 books are there. It is the smallest version of the New Testament. It is in Greek. The company wants to produce many of these chips. They want everyone to have one. The chip is small – it can fit into watches, for example. The company has big plans. They want to make another chip. This chip will have the Old Testament on it. Difficult words: company (a business), New Testament (the second part of the Christian Bible, written originally in Greek), Old Testament (the first part of the Christian Bible). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Akamara in Abkhazia is a ghost town given up to nature. People built the mining town back in the 1970s in the Soviet Union and it had 5,000 residents . After the collapse of the USSR , the town was in Georgia. However, there was a war during 1992–93 when Abkhaz separatists broke from Georgia which led to the first exodus . The second emigration took place during the 2008 conflict between Georgia and Russia. Today, there are only 35 residents left and the forest is reclaiming public areas and abandoned buildings. Difficult words: resident (a person who resides – lives somewhere), USSR (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics = Soviet Union), separatist (a person who wants to separate an area of a country to become a new country), exodus (a big emigration), reclaim (take back what was once yours), abandoned (not used, without any people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Akamara is a town which people built in the 1970s in the Soviet Union. It was a mining town and had 5,000 residents . The Soviet Union collapsed and the town was in Georgia. However, the town was in an area called Abkhazia and Abkhaz separatists wanted to leave Georgia. There was a war during 1992–93 and many people left. More people left during the 2008 conflict between Georgia and Russia, and today, there are only 35 residents left. Akamara is a ghost town – trees grow out of buildings and animals are in the streets. Nature is taking over. Difficult words: resident (a person who resides – lives somewhere), collapse (end), separatist (a person who wants to separate an area of a country to become a new country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Akamara is a town. People build it in the 1970s. It is a mining town . Around 5,000 people live there. There is a war in 1992 and 1993. Many people leave the town. Even more people leave in 2008. Now, only 35 people live in Akamara. It is a ghost town . Trees grow out of buildings. There are animals in the streets. Nature is taking over . Difficult words: mining town (a town where most people work in mines – get coal or something else from the ground), ghost town (an empty town – without people), take over (be the boss of something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Rescuers rushed to an area in the South China Sea where Typhoon Chaba snapped a ship in two; the ship had a crew of 30 on board. Strong waves caused substantial damage, and then the ship broke into two pieces. Chinese authorities released footage of a person airlifted to safety while waves crashed over the deck of the semi-submerged vessel. Officials said that three people were rescued from the sinking ship; however, the fate of the other 27 people on the vessel remained unknown. Search operations were still underway for the missing crew members. China’s first typhoon of the year brought gales and rain to China’s southern shores. Forecasters warned of record rainfall and high disaster risk in the country’s most populous provinces. Difficult words: semi-submerged (partially underwater), fate (the things that will happen in the future), gale (a very strong wind). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

China’s first typhoon of the year brought strong winds and rain to the southern part of the country. Strong sea waves damaged a ship in the South China Sea, and then the ship broke in half. Rescuers rushed to the area, and they tried to save the crew. 30 people were on board, and rescuers airlifted three of them. At that moment, half of the ship was already underwater. Officials said that they didn’t know what happened to the 27 other people, but rescuers were searching for them. Experts warned that the typhoon could cause a disaster in southern China, one of the country’s most populous areas. Difficult words: typhoon (a strong storm in the Pacific Ocean), airlift (to move people or things by air, usually in a difficult or dangerous situation), populous (a place where many people live). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A typhoon hits China. It is the first storm this year. It brings strong winds and heavy rains. They go to the south of the country. Very high waves are in the South China Sea. Ships have problems. One ship breaks in half. 30 people are on board. Rescuers try to get to the ship quickly. The ship is sinking . Rescuers are in a helicopter above the ship. Rescuers save three people. Nobody knows where the other 27 people are. Experts say that more rain and strong winds will come. Millions of people live in the south of China. The storm can destroy many homes. Difficult words: typhoon (a strong storm in the Pacific Ocean), sink (to go to the bottom), destroy (to damage something a lot). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A Chinese spacecraft named Tianwen-1 took images that cover the entire planet of Mars. The spacecraft reached Mars in February 2021, and since that time, it circled the planet more than 1,300 times. Its data includes visuals of Mars’s south pole which holds almost all of the planet’s water. Other images show the 4,000-kilometer long canyon Valles Marineris and the impact craters of Arabia Terra. The location of subsurface water is important to determine the planet’s potential for life, and it also gives a permanent resource for human exploration. The name of the robotic spacecraft actually has six separate pieces of equipment: an orbiter, two deployable cameras, a lander, a remote camera, and a rover. It has no crew. The probe traveled a total of 475 million kilometers, and after the US, the feat made China the second country to successfully land on Mars. Difficult words: subsurface (the material that is below the surface of the ground), deployable (to move to a place where something can be used), feat (a difficult act that requires a lot of skill or courage to achieve it). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In July 2020, a Chinese spacecraft named Tianwen-1 started its mission to Mars. The spacecraft traveled 475 million kilometers, and it finally reached the planet in February 2021. The spacecraft orbited the planet more than 1,300 times, and it took a lot of images. The images show the whole planet in many details. Some images show the planet’s south pole. Under the pole is almost all of the planet’s water, which is very important for scientists. They believe that life can be there with water there. Only two countries successfully landed on Mars: the US and China. Just like with the US mission, no crew was on the spacecraft. Difficult words: mission (a long and difficult journey), orbit (to go around), crew (a group of people that work on a ship, plane, or other vehicle). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tianwen-1 is a Chinese spacecraft. In July 2020, the spacecraft starts its journey to Mars. No people are on the spacecraft. The journey takes seven months. The spacecraft travels 475 million kilometers. It gets to Mars in February 2021. The spacecraft goes around Mars 1,300 times. It takes many pictures. Mars is a very important planet. Some pictures show the bottom of Mars. Water is under this area. Scientists believe that life can be in the water. Other pictures show craters , and valleys , and mountains. The spacecraft is the second to go to Mars. The first spacecraft is the US spacecraft. Its name is Viking 1. It goes to Mars in the 1970s. Difficult words: journey (a long or difficult trip), crater (a hole in the ground from a large rock that falls from space), valley (a low area between two mountains or hills). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Residents in New South Wales, Australia had a horrifying shock when thousands of baby spiders quite literally rained down from the sky. Creepy-crawlies invade the town; people found homes and gardens covered with the spiders and mounds of their silky threads. The terrifying scenes would probably cause mass panic in most places, however the phenomenon commonly known as ‘Spider Rain’, ‘Angel Hair’ and ‘ballooning’, is not uncommon across parts of Australia. Ballooning is a form of spider transportation which is when some species of spiders climb to the highest heights that they possibly can, like on the tops of plants or trees. They then use their web as parachutes and leap off. The silk catches on the breeze and carries the spider. People are then left with the gossamer , which is the name for the silver sheets of silken webs left behind. Reportedly, this is going on around us all the time, but at a much smaller scale. The spiders can often travel a pretty big distance and people have seen some come flying more than 2.9 kilometres above the ground. Spiders are thought to come raining down because of a preceding change in a weather conditions. If it rains a lot and the ground gets waterlogged , spiders move their way upwards to avoid drowning. Difficult words: literally (actually), creepy-crawly (an insect), mound (a lot of things on top of each other), phenomenon (an event), species (a type of animal), gossamer (thin, silver pieces of a web), waterlog (be full of water). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

When it rains a lot, there are some types of spiders that balloon to get away from the water. The spider jumps off a tall tree or plant and flies by using its web silk to float through the air. This is a normal event. What happened in Australia was not a normal event because thousands of baby spiders ballooned into a town all at one time. The skies rained down the spiders and their webs now cover gardens and homes in mounds . There were so many webs, the town looked like something from a horror movie. Difficult words: balloon verb (when a spider’s web helps it fly through the air), float (to move slowly in the air), mound (a bunch of things on top of each other). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Some spiders live on the ground. If it rains a lot, these spiders leave. They climb plants. They climb trees. They jump from the trees or the plants. Their web silk comes out. They fly with it. We call this ballooning. This happens a lot. Only some spiders do this at one time. However, thousands of spiders ballooned from somewhere. They rained on a town. This was in Australia. They covered everything with their webs. The webs looked like mounds . It looked scary. Difficult words: climb (to go up), web silk (the silver stuff that comes from of a spider), mound (a hill). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Footage, which originally surfaced on social media and people think was shot in Venezuela, shows two men standing on a whale shark while being towed by a speedboat. British conservationist group Marine Connection reacted angrily to the footage and called for both men to be charged, adding that wildlife harassment is never a laughing matter and it said that the whale shark is a protected and vulnerable species . Measuring up to 12 metres in length, the whale shark is the largest living fish in the world. Despite being called a shark, it poses no threat to humans, and feeds mainly on plankton and small fish. Difficult words: tow (to pull), vulnerable (in danger), species (animal kind), pose (show), plankton (a very small shrimp). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A video shot in Venezuela appeared on social media. It shows two men who stand on a whale shark, and a speedboat pulls them. A conservationist group reacted angrily to the footage. It said that the stupid and arrogant men harassed the animal, and that they should be brought to justice . The whale shark is the largest living fish in the world. They are not dangerous to humans – they only eat small fish and other small organisms. Difficult words: conservationist group (a group of people who want to conserve/protect nature), harass (to do something bad to somebody or something), to bring somebody to justice (to arrest somebody and bring him or her to court). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Two men are in Venezuela. They stand on a whale shark . They hold a rope . A boat pulls the rope. Someone films all of this. That person puts the video on the Internet. An organisation sees the video. This organisation helps animals. The organisation does not like the video. It makes the people there angry. They say that the men are stupid. They want to bring the men to justice . The whale shark is the biggest fish in the world. It is not dangerous. It only eats small fish. Difficult words: whale shark (the animal in the picture), rope (a line), to bring somebody to justice (to take somebody to the police station and then to court). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
